resource_basis.scope: Three source-order native-level4 Float64 value/AD resource cases and their complete cached workflow; run products remain outside git.
resource_basis.unmeasured_costs: Full physical256-bit independent Jacobian and inward-reference workloads were not executed in the resource pilot. Their initial larger engineering budgets below are prospective limits, not calibrated throughput or G2PERF acceptance.

execution.point_order: Exact order of the fully verified source request; p0001..p0132 are scheduling indices, never replacements for source IDs or rounded geometries.
execution.fixed_geometry_preparation_only: Existing pinned native/provider calls may prepare each fixed geometry before Julia-only parameter evaluation. Hold one geometry at a time; discard it before preparing the next.

phases.native123: One complete Julia producer/auditor pair per source point records all first3 declared native levels at bound24. Coarse target misses remain unaccepted observations. A global Julia decision requires every132 source identity before selecting level3 or requesting level4.
phases.native4: Only when global level3 misses, run every132 point at declared level4. A global Julia decision accepts one common level for all132 or fails after exhausting the unchanged ladder.
phases.tailref123: At the common native level, each point job prepares bound12 then discards that context, prepares bound32, checks the bound24-to32 tail, independent scalar composition, all13 candidate gradients/HVP, independent256-bit Jacobian and all first3 declared inward reference steps. Keep full decimal256-bit value/Jacobian samples and every coarse miss.
phases.reference4: Only when the global third-step derivative decision misses, run every132 point at the fourth declared step, reprepare bound32 at the common native level and bind its adjacent third-step operands to the original point report. No threshold, parameter, native level or source identity changes.
phases.global_derivative: Use one common third or fourth derivative refinement level after all132/all13 candidate/reference/inward and adjacent comparisons meet the unchanged contract. A subset, missing sample or mixed native level cannot authorize the complete diagnostic.
phases.source_math: Separate explicitly synthetic positive-count two-angle Fourier, target-sum and closed-stencil controls use the actual source metadata and unchanged scientific policy. They cannot substitute for any physical point/reference record.
phases.final: An independent complete Julia reader validates the exact132 coverage, all original job resources/source/build/code/output bindings, current arithmetic and the common native/derivative decisions before comparison CSV and separate experiment figures are generated.

resources.measurement: Retain GNU time direct-child maximum RSS, wall/user/system time and child exit for complete commands; separately retain wrapper outcome, interruption, monotonic duration, tool hash/version and Julia phase observations. This is not simultaneous process-tree peak RSS.

reporting.physical_gradient_reference_scope: Independent generic fixed-row assembly and256-bit arithmetic; native rows and initial functions remain shared.
reporting.acceptance: Complete fixed-center132-point reconstructed-theory diagnostic only, after every required physical and source-math check. No fitting, production, full-x moment, performance or coverage approval.
reporting.limitations: Preserve every parent missing-code, rounded-state, source-range, source-phase/transcription, target-model, covariance/overlap, acceptance and existing scientific benchmark FAIL limitation.
